title: Nixon's filing-cabinet folder of alien body photographs
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Nixon's filing-cabinet folder of alien body photographs, about 1969-1974 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that story is true. And there was a story that that he had folders. He had a folder in his filing cabinet with the with the alien dead bodies and they would show these photographs.

plain: Grant Cameron, a longtime researcher of UFO stories, passes on a tale about Richard Nixon from his years as president, 1969 to 1974. Cameron says Nixon was said to keep a folder in his filing cabinet holding photographs of dead alien bodies, and that these pictures were shown to people. If true, it would mean a sitting president personally held proof of beings from elsewhere.
